tzar: A tzar is a male monarch or emperor.
Tzar means the same as czar or tsar.
tzara: Tzara is French poet who was one of the cofounders of the dada movement.
Tzara means the same as Tristan Tzara or Samuel Rosenstock.
tzarina: A tzarina is the wife or widow of a czar.
Tzarina means the same as czarina or tsarina or czaritza.
tzetze: Tzetze means the same as tsetse fly or tsetse or tzetze fly.
tzetze fly: Tzetze fly is bloodsucking African fly.
Tzetze fly means the same as tsetse fly or tsetse or tzetze.
tzarist: Tzarist means of or relating to or characteristic of a czar.
Tzarist means the same as czarist or czaristic or tsarist.
